blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in gigapixel-level imaging have brought High-Resolution Wide shots to the forefront of research. However, these images present significant challenges: extreme sparsity of foreground, gigapixel-level resolutions and diverse target counts. This makes traditional close-up detectors inaccurate and slow as they are overwhelmed by the background. Although previous research has explored sparse backbones, their fixed sparsity patterns lack the adaptability required to handle diverse target numbers. To address this, we introduce ElasticFormer, a sparse backbone that dynamically allocates computational resources based on foreground proportion. After scoring windows based on variance, proposed ElasticSelector module will predict the foreground proportion for top-k selection. The mechanism guides the model to select target-containing windows, scaling resources in areas where objects are clustered. We introduce a novel loss function combined with the 3-phase training strategy for ElasticSelector, allowing it to function properly when bounding box annotations are missing. A WSOD study is carried on PASCAL VOC 2007 to evaluate its extensibility. Further, ElasticNet is created to verify its backbone-agnostic nature. In experiments on the PANDA gigapixel benchmark, ElasticFormer reduces backbone FLOPs by 80% while achieving a significant improvement in AP50 when compared to fixed-ratio sparse methods.
blocks.zh: 最近千兆像素级成像工作的进展,使高分辨率宽镜头成为研究的前沿。 然而,这些图像提出了重大挑战:前景的极端模糊;千兆像素级分辨率和各种目标计数。 这使得传统的特写探测器不准确而缓慢,因为它们被背景所压倒. 尽管之前的研究探索了稀有的骨干,但其固定的筋挛模式缺乏处理不同目标数所需的适应性. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了ElasticFormer, 一个稀有的主干线,根据前景比例动态分配计算资源. 在基于差异的评分窗口后,所拟议的ElasticSelector模块会预测出顶-k选择的前景比例. 该机制指导模型选择包含目标的窗口,在对象集群的区域缩放资源. 我们引入了一种新的损失功能,结合了“弹性选择器”的三相培训策略,使其在框注缺失时能够正常运行。 对2007年PASCAL VOC进行了WSOD研究,以评估其扩展性。 此外,还创建了弹性网络,以验证其骨干不可知性。 在PANDA Gigapixel基准的实验中,ElasticFormer将骨干FLOP减少了80%,同时与固定比例稀有方法相比,AP50取得了显著的改进.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Object detection is a core task in computer vision that involves both locating and identifying objects of interest in an image. It typically produces, for each detected instance, a category label and a spatial extent (usually an axis-aligned bounding box). Models such as Fast R-CNN [ 18 ] have demonstrated strong performance on MS COCO [ 25 ] . However, with the development of nondestructive high-resolution imaging systems, High-Resolution Wide (HRW) shots detection has drawn increasing attention [ 6 , 16 ] , which refers to object detection in imagery characterized by extremely high spatial resolution and a wide field of view, such as images captured by gigapixel-scale drone [ 33 ] , satellite [ 37 , 13 , 12 ] , or panoramic camera [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 对象检测是计算机视觉中的一项核心任务,涉及定位和识别图像中感兴趣的对象. 它通常为每个被检测到的例子产生分类标签和空间范围(通常是轴相匹配的边框). Fast R-CNN[18]等型号在MS COCO[25]上表现出了强大的性能. 然而,随着无损高分辨率成像系统的发展,高分辨率广射探测已引起越来越多的注意[6,16],指在空间分辨率极高和视野宽的图像中进行物体探测,如千兆像素级无人机捕获的图像[33],卫星[37,13,12],或全景相机. [4].

blocks.en: Firstly, in HRW scenarios, foreground density is much lower than that in conventional detection images. While typical datasets have foregrounds covering over 50% of the image, HRW images often contain less than 15% [ 22 ] , with large background regions such as sky or vegetation. Given such extreme sparsity, cutting-edge detectors, including DINO [ 40 ] , Deformable DETR [ 43 ] , RMT [ 17 ] , among others, still struggle with overwhelming background.
blocks.zh: 首先,在人权观察的情景中,前景密度远远低于传统的探测图像。 虽然典型的数据集有覆盖50%以上图像的展望,但人权观察的图像往往不足15%[22],其背景区域很大,如天空或植被。 鉴于这种极端的痉挛现象,尖端探测器,包括DINO[40],变形DETR[43],RTT[17]等等,仍然在压倒性的背景中挣扎.

blocks.en: Secondly, limited computational resources pose another challenge. HRW detection scenarios (e.g., UAV-based inspection [ 14 ] and medical detection [ 24 ] ) often require real-time responsiveness. As resolution scales from millions of pixels in COCO [ 25 ] to billions in PANDA [ 2 ] , the cost of conventional detectors grows polynomially with input size, leading to inference up to two orders of magnitude slower.
blocks.zh: 第二,有限的计算资源构成另一个挑战。 人权观察检测假想(如基于无人驾驶航空器的检查[14]和医疗检测[24])往往需要实时响应. 随着分辨率从COCO[25]百万像素到PANDA[2]数十亿像素的大小,常规探测器的成本随着输入体积的增大而增高,导致推论速度放缓至两个数量级.

blocks.en: Thirdly, HRW scenarios show extreme variation in target counts, ranging from a few to dozens, as shown in Figure 1 (a). Thus models must remain effective across both sparse and dense cases. However, existing approaches such as SaccadeDet [ 23 ] and SparseFormer [ 22 ] overlook this issue, as they rely on fixed sparsity rates that fail to adapt to fluctuations in target quantity. Consequently, their effectiveness is significantly reduced when confronted with highly variable target distributions, illustrated in Figure 1 (b).
blocks.zh: 第三,如图1(a)所示,人权观察的情景显示,目标数差异极大,从几到几十不等。 因此,模式必须有效处理稀少和密集的案件。 但是,SaccadeDet [23] 和SparseFormer [22] 等现有办法忽略了这一问题,因为它们依赖于固定的痉挛率,无法适应目标数量的波动。 因此,如图1(b)所示,在面临高度变化不定的目标分布时,其效力显著降低。

blocks.en: Inspired by human cognitive efficiency and recent advances [ 1 , 32 , 7 , 41 , 19 ] , we propose ElasticFormer, a detection framework that introduces elasticity into backbone design. Unlike fixed-ratio methods that waste computation in HRW scenes with highly variable foreground proportion, ElasticFormer dynamically allocates resources by adaptively selecting image patches according to the predicted foreground proportion. A lightweight module, ElasticSelector, guides patch selection independently at each stage in backbone, enabling fine-grained perception while scaling cost with foreground proportion rather than overall image size. It is noteworthy that ElasticSelector is backbone-agnostic, motivating the creation of ElasticNet for verification. Experiments show that ElasticFormer reduces computation by up to 80% while improving accuracy compared with SparseFormer [ 22 ] , ElasticNet also achieves a 87% computational saving compared with ResNet-50 [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 在人类认知效率和近期进步[1,32,7,41,19]的启发下,我们提出"弹性Former",这个检测框架将弹性引入骨干设计. 与在超可变前缘比例的人权观察场景中浪费计算功能的固定比例方法不同,ElasticFormer通过适应性地根据预测前缘比例选择图像补丁来动态地分配资源. 一个轻量级模块,ElasticSelector,在主干线的每个阶段独立地引导补丁选择,能够使精细的感知,同时以前景比例而不是整体图像大小来缩放成本. 值得注意的是,“弹性选手”具有骨干不可知性,促使创建“弹性选手网”进行核查。 实验显示,与SparseFormer[22]相比,ElasticFormer在提高精度的同时将计算减少高达80%,而与ResNet-50[20]相比,ElasticNet也实现了87%的计算节约.

blocks.en: A further challenge in weakly supervised object detection (WSOD) is the absence of bounding-box annotations, making foreground proportion hard to compute. To address this, we design a new loss function for ElasticSelector, which uses either ground truth or pseudo labels as supervision. Validation on the PASCAL VOC 2007 dataset [ 1 ] demonstrates that this extension reduces FLOPs by at least 50% while improving both mAP and CorLoc.
blocks.zh: 弱监督对象检测(WSOD)的另一个挑战是缺乏边框说明,使得前景比例难以计算. 为了解决这个问题,我们为ElasticSelector设计了一种新的损失功能,它使用地面真理或假标签作为监督. 对PASCAL VOC 2007数据集的验证[1]显示,这种扩展将FLOP至少减少50%,同时改进mAP和CorLoc.

blocks.en: To summarize, our key contributions are:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: ∙ \bullet We propose ElasticFormer, a novel sparse Vision Transformer-based backbone that not only addresses the extremely sparse target distribution and redundant background in HRW images, but also dynamically adapts to varying numbers of targets across diverse scenes. ∙ \bullet We further introduce a lightweight component, ElasticSelector, which dynamically predicts the foreground proportion during the forward inference process based on intermediate features, providing efficient guidance with negligible additional computational overhead. ∙ \bullet We design a label-free loss function that minimizes the gap between the predicted and actual foreground proportions, enabling self-supervised optimization of ElasticSelector without the need for extra annotations. ∙ \bullet We validate the proposed backbone on PANDA [ 2 ] and PASCAL VOC 2007 [ 1 ] datasets, and further extend our backbone-agnostic design to CNN-based architectures, consistently demonstrating its effectiveness and generality across model families.

blocks.en: Object Detection in High-Resolution Wide Shots. HRW detection addresses the critical challenge of locating sparse objects in gigapixel-scale imagery, where target coverage is often below 15% and background is highly diverse [ 2 ] , different from ImageNet [ 11 ] . While general-purpose detectors like Faster R-CNN [ 18 ] and Deformable Convolutional Networks [ 9 ] achieve strong performance on dense scenes, their cost scales prohibitively with input resolution, causing severe latency. Shufflenet [ 42 ] reduces complexity via grouped convolutions, yet lacks adaptive computation. DynamicDet [ 27 ] routes images by predicted difficulty, but its binary partitioning is ill-suited to HRW shots and maintaining dual branches is cumbersome. While DGE [ 31 ] has been applied to enhance vision transformer, it lacks the flexibility required to effectively handle HRW scenarios.
blocks.zh: 在高分辨率宽射弹中探测物体。 监测站的检测工作涉及在千兆像素图像中查找稀有物体这一关键挑战,其中目标覆盖面往往低于15%,背景高度多样化[2],不同于ImageNet[11]。 虽然更快的R-CNN[18]和可变的革命网络[9]等通用探测器在密集场景中取得了强效性能,但其成本尺度在输入分辨率上令人望而却步,造成了严重的耐久性. Shufflenet[42]通过分组演化减少复杂性,但缺乏适应性计算. 动态Det[27]通过预测难度来引导图像,但其二进制分区不适合人权观察拍摄,维护双分支是繁琐的. 虽然DGE[31]已应用于增强视力变换器,但它缺乏有效处理人权观察设想所需的灵活性。

blocks.en: Vision Transformers for Detection. Transformers have revolutionized NLP, and Vision Transformers (ViTs) extend this success to detection by modeling long-range dependencies. However, conventional ViTs process all image tokens equally, incurring quadratic complexity with input size. To reduce cost, methods such as window-based attention [ 28 , 44 ] , multi-layer self-attention [ 35 ] , and low-rank projection [ 2 ] have been proposed. Yet these approaches still face a trade-off between efficiency and accuracy, limiting their effectiveness in HRW detection.
blocks.zh: 视觉变形器用于检测. 变形器革命化了NLP,而Vision变形器(ViTs)通过建模远程依赖性将这一成功扩展到检测. 然而,常规 ViTs处理所有图像符号均匀,产生四进制复杂,输入大小. 为降低成本,提出了基于窗口的注意[28,44],多层自留心[35],低排名预测[2]等方法. 然而,这些办法在效率和准确性之间仍面临权衡,限制了在监测站的检查中的有效性。

blocks.en: Sparse Computation Methods. Sparse detection paradigms reduce redundancy by focusing on informative regions. Dynamic token pruning [ 29 ] adjust computation per instance but remains limited by rigid backbones. Saliency-guided approaches like SaccadeDet [ 23 ] use auxiliary networks to predict candidate regions but introduce cascaded latency and struggle with extreme scale variations in HRW scenes. Fixed-ratio sparsification, exemplified by SparseFormer [ 22 ] , retain a preset fraction of tokens, which wastes resources in sparse regions and under-allocates in dense ones. Critically, no existing method dynamically modulates token utilization across backbone stages based on spatially varying target density—a gap our ElasticSelector and ElasticFormer explicitly address.
blocks.zh: 斯帕塞计算方法. Sparse检测范式通过注重信息化区域来减少冗余. 动态令牌推算 [29] 调整每个实例的计算,但仍受到刚性主干的限制. 诸如SaccadeDet[23]等有显著指导性的方法利用辅助网络预测候选地区,但在人权观察的场景中引入了连锁延缓和与极端规模差异作斗争。 SparseFormer[22]为例,固定比例螺丝虫化保留了预设部分的代币,这些代币将稀疏区域的资源浪费在稀疏区域,将稀有的稀释物浪费在稠密区域。 关键是,没有任何现有方法能动态地调节不同主干阶段的象征性使用,而这种使用是基于空间上不同的目标密度——这是我们“弹性选择器”和“弹性前置器”明确地址的差距。

blocks.en: In the main network, input image is partitioned into non-overlapping patches of size ( H 4 × W 4 × 48 \frac{H}{4}\times\frac{W}{4}\times 48 ) where H H and W W denote the original size of input. Through linear embedding layer, the number of channel is projected into C C in the first stage. In subsequent stages, the width and height of the feature maps are progressively halved while channel doubled by merging patches, reshaping the size into ( H 8 × W 8 × 2 ​ C \frac{H}{8}\times\frac{W}{8}\times 2C ) for global attention. Feature maps from global attention will be partitioned into winodws of size w × w w\times w for local attention, Figure 2 demonstrates a example of w = 3 w=3 , partitioning the feature map into 9 windows. Within each stage, the global attention and local attention modules appear in paired blocks, repeated d i d_{i} times. We refer to this repetition count as the depth of that stage, which is set to [ 2 , 2 , 6 , 2 ] [2,2,6,2] in ElasticFormer.
blocks.zh: 在主网络中,输入图像被分割成大小不重叠的补丁(H 4×W 4×48\frac{H}{4}\times\frac{W}{4}\times 48),其中H和WW表示输入的原始大小. 通过线性嵌入层,在第一阶段将通道数投射到C C. 在随后的阶段,通过合并补丁,将功能图的宽度和高度逐渐减半,同时将频道翻倍,将大小重塑为(H 8 × W 8 × 2 C\frac{H}{8}\times\frac{W}{8}\times 2C),供全球关注. 来自全局关注的地物图会被分割成大小w × w\ times w,供局部关注,图2显示了一个w=3 w=3的例子,将地物图分割为9个窗口. 在每个阶段,全球关注和当地关注模块都以成对的块形式出现,重复d i d_{i}时间. 我们把这一重复计数称为该阶段的深度,该阶段被设定为[2,2,6,2] [2,2,6,2]在ElasticFormer.

blocks.en: In Figure 2 , we illustrate the structure of an Elastic Selection module in Stage 2 as an example. The feature map is divided into nine windows, each evaluated by the scoring module to obtain a score. Leveraging a variance-based mechanism, the scoring module assigns higher scores to windows containing richer foreground content. For visualization, windows are shaded with different intensities according to their scores: darker colors indicate higher scores and thus more foreground. Two extreme cases of foreground distribution are shown. In the sparse case, only the upper windows receive high scores, while in the dense case, most windows achieve high scores since they all contain substantial foreground regions.
blocks.zh: 在图2中,我们举例说明第二阶段弹性选择模块的结构。 特征图分为9个窗口,每个窗口由评分模块评价以获得分数. 利用基于差异的机制,评分模块为含有较丰富的前景内容的窗口分配更高的分数. 对于可视化,视窗根据分数有不同强度的遮荫:较暗的颜色表示分数较高,因此更前卫. 显示了两个前缘分布的极端案例. 在稀疏的情况下,只有上窗获得高分,而在稠密的情况下,大多数窗口都获得高分,因为它们都包含大量的前缘区域.

blocks.en: After scoring, ElasticSelector predicts the overall foreground proportion of the image, which is used as the sparsity rate to guide a top‑k selection of windows according to their scores. Discarded windows are marked with black hatching, while the selected ones retain their color and are forwarded to local attention for further foreground feature extraction. The intermediate visualization clearly illustrates how window selection adapts under different foreground proportions, highlighting both sparse and dense cases within the image. Here the proposed ℒ select \mathcal{L}_{\text{select}} takes the GT foreground ratio ρ \rho as a supervisory signal, guiding ElasticSelector to produce accurate predictions ρ ^ \hat{\rho} .
blocks.zh: 评分后,ElasticSelector预测图像的总体前景比例,该比例作为sparsity率,用于根据各窗口的分数来引导一个顶端选择. 被丢弃的窗口被标记为黑色孵化,而被选中的窗口则保留其颜色,并转发给当地关注,以进一步挖掘前缘特征. 中间可视化清晰地说明了窗口选择在不同前缘比例下是如何适应的,突出显示图像中零星和密集的病例. 在此, 提议的 L 选择 \ mathcal{ L\\ text{ select} 将 GT 前景比 $\rho 作为监管信号, 引导 ElasticSelector 生成准确的预测 ^ ^ \ hat\rho} 。

blocks.en: 3.2 Elastic Selection
blocks.zh: 3.2 弹性选择

blocks.en: Definition of foreground proportion. To establish a transparent and interpretable basis for adaptive computation allocation within ElasticFormer, we choose the foreground proportion ρ \rho as the guidance. This ratio provides a direct geometric measure of the spatial complexity of an image by quantifying the overall area of all objects. First, we define ρ \rho as: ρ = α ⋅ ∪ i BBox i H ⋅ W . \rho=\alpha\cdot\frac{\cup_{i}\text{BBox}_{i}}{H\cdot W}. (1)

blocks.en: 3-Phase training strategy. When training ElasticSelector using pseudo-GT, the model initially generates highly disordered bounding boxes. Under these conditions, the computed density values cannot effectively guide the optimization of ElasticSelector’s parameters and may even exert a negative effect on learning. Moreover, since the backbone’s token budget is directly determined by the density predicted by ElasticSelector, underestimation of density leads to a reduction in supervisory signals for the backbone, thereby impairing its convergence.
blocks.zh: 3. 阶段培训战略。 在使用伪GT来训练ElasticSelector时,该模型最初会产生高度无序的边框. 在这些条件下,计算密度值不能有效地指导优化ElasticSelector的参数,甚至可能对学习产生负面影响。 此外,由于骨干象征性的预算直接由弹性选择器预测的密度决定,低估密度会导致骨干的监督信号减少,从而影响骨干趋同。

blocks.en: We therefore seek to train ElasticSelector with more stable pseudo‐GT and to allow the backbone to utilize more tokens during the early period of training, thereby accelerating its convergence. However, a full decoupling of the two branches is not warranted, as achieving a balance between computational overhead and detection accuracy necessitates their coordinated operation. To this end, we introduce a 3‐phase training strategy:
blocks.zh: 因此,我们试图训练弹性选手 更稳定的伪... ... 使骨干在培训初期能够利用更多的标志,从而加快其融合。 然而,没有必要将这两个处完全脱钩,因为要实现计算间接费用与检测准确性之间的平衡,就必须协调它们的运作。 为此,我们推行了三阶段培训战略:

blocks.en: First, we freeze ElasticSelector and force the backbone to train on all token, ignoring ρ ^ \hat{\rho} . This guarantees that the backbone receives sufficient supervisory signal and prevents useless updates to ElasticSelector.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们冻结“弹性选择器” 并强迫骨干在各种场合训练,而忽略了 $ ^ \ \ \ \ rho 。 这保证了骨干能够收到足够的监管信号,并防止对ElasticSelector无用的更新.

blocks.en: Second, once the backbone’s outputs have stabilized, we unfreeze ElasticSelector to drive its initial convergence and obtain more reliable density estimates. However, ρ ^ \hat{\rho} is still ignored in this phase.
blocks.zh: 第二,一旦骨干输出稳定下来,我们就解冻ElasticSelector来推动其最初的趋同,并获得更可靠的密度估计。 然而,这阶段仍然被忽视。

blocks.en: Third, we put ρ ^ \hat{\rho} in use, enabling the network to autonomously balance computational load against detection accuracy.

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: Our primary evaluation is conducted on the PANDA [ 2 ] dataset, the first human-centric gigapixel-level benchmark featuring 13 training and 5 testing scenes with approximately 16 million annotated bounding boxes. The average image resolution of this dataset, 25,000 × \times 16,000 pixels, presents unprecedented computational demands, establishing a rigorous testbed for efficiency assessment.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要评价是在PANDA[2]数据集上进行的,这是第一个以人为中心的千兆像素水平基准,有13个培训和5个测试场景,有大约1 600万个附加说明的边框。 这个数据集的平均图像分辨率为25,000 ×\times 16,000像素,提出了前所未有的计算需求,为效率评估建立了严格的测试床.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价尺度

blocks.en: Model efficiency is quantified using FLOPs and standard COCO metrics, with particular emphasis on AP 50 \text{AP}_{50} , AP small \text{AP}_{\text{small}} ( < 96 × 96 <96\times 96 ), AP medium \text{AP}_{\text{medium}} ( 96 × 96 ∼ 288 × 288 96\times 96\sim 288\times 288 ) and AP large \text{AP}_{\text{large}} ( > 288 × 288 >288\times 288 ). We further record the FLOPs on foreground (FLOPs-F) and background (FLOPs-B) to provide a more fine‑grained evaluation of model. To ensure fair comparison, all detectors process uniformly cropped 1280×800 windows from test images. Given the dynamic token selection mechanism in ElasticFormer, its FLOPs are estimated by averaging measurements across the test set. All implementations utilized the MMDetection [ 5 ] framework under standardized 36-epoch training protocols.
blocks.zh: 模型效率通过FLOPs和标准COCO度量法量化,特别强调AP 50\text{AP}_{50},AP小\text{小\text{( < 96 × 96 <96\tims 96),AP中\text{中\(96 × 288 × 288 96\tim 288)和AP大\text{大\text{( > 288×288>288\tims 288) 。我们进一步记录了前景FLOPs(FLOPs-F)和背景(FLOPs-B),以便对模型进行更精细的评价。 为了确保公平比较,所有探测器都从测试图像中统一裁剪1280x800窗口。 鉴于ElasticFormer中的动态符号选择机制,其FLOP是通过整个测试集的平均值测量来估计的. 所有执行都利用了标准化的36世纪培训协议下的MM探测[5]框架。

blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 关于PANDA的数据分析

blocks.en: As presented in Table 1 , traditional detectors consistently exceed 200 GFLOPs for backbone computation on PANDA [ 2 ] , whereas modern Transformer-based approaches like Dynamic-head [ 10 ] and DINO [ 40 ] reduces computational costs to sub-100 GFLOPs. SparseFormer achieves further reduction to 75.71 GFLOPs through fixed-ratio token selection while delivering significant AP gains.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,传统的探测器在PANDA[2]的骨干计算中一直超过200 GFLOP,而以Dynamic-head[10]和DINO[40]等现代变压器为基础的方法则将计算成本降至100 GFLOP。 SparseFormer通过固定比例符号选择,实现了进一步削减至75.71 GFLOP,同时取得了显著的AP收益.

blocks.en: Whether integrated with Dynamic‑Head [ 10 ] or DINO [ 40 ] , our ElasticFormer delivers superior performance under significantly lower computational cost. Combined with DINO, our backbone outperforms the SparseFormer [ 22 ] by 3.3% AP 50 while consuming only 13.13 GFLOPs. This represents a 82.7% computational reduction compared to SparseFormer and an 90.2% reduction relative to Swin-T [ 28 ] , demonstrating highly efficient sparse computation. The computational reduction stems from dramatically curtailing redundant background computations: the ElasticFormer expends merely 8.9% of the computational resources wasted by its SparseFormer counterpart on background regions.
blocks.zh: 无论是与 Dynamic-Head [10] 或 DINO [40] 合并, 我们的“弹性前导”在显著较低的计算成本下提供优异的性能。 加上DINO,我们的骨干业绩比SparseFormer [22] 高3.3%的AP 50,而只消耗了13.13 GFLOPs. 与SparseFormer相比,计算减少82.7%,与Swin-T[28]相比,计算减少90.2%,这表明计算效率很高。 计算量的减少是由于大幅度削减了多余的背景计算:弹性前期只花费了SparseFormer对应方在背景地区浪费的8.9%的计算资源。

blocks.en: 4.4 3-Phase Training Strategy
blocks.zh: 4.4 第三阶段培训战略

blocks.en: Comparison of strategies. As shown in Table 3 , 3-phase strategy is consistently better than 1-phase (utilizing ElasticSelector all the time). The results demonstrate that the 3-phase strategy effectively mitigates the impact of early ρ ^ \hat{\rho} noise on overall training. Moreover, with 3-phase strategy, results on GT under-performs pesudo-GT. This is because the noise in pseudo-GT can effectively enhance model generalization during joint optimization (Phase 3).
blocks.zh: 战略比较。 如表3所示,三阶段战略一贯优于一阶段(始终利用弹性选择器)。 结果表明,三阶段战略有效地减轻了早期的 ^ ^ hat{\rho} 噪音对整个培训的影响。 此外,通过三阶段战略,GT业绩不佳的pesudo-GT的结果。 这是因为伪GT中的噪声能够在联合优化(第3阶段)期间有效增强模型的泛化.

blocks.en: Balancing Phase 1 and 3. To mitigate mutual interference between the ElasticSelector pathway and the main backbone during early training, we implement a controlled 3-phase training regimen (detailed in Section 3.4) that gradually activates end-to-end coupling. The initial transition point is set after epoch 12, where ElasticSelector begins training without yet influencing the backbone. Analysis of loss convergence patterns during 1-phase training determines that Phase 2 spans 3 epochs, sufficient for ElasticSelector stabilization before initiating joint optimization (Phase 3).
blocks.zh: 平衡第1和第3阶段。 为了减少在早期训练中弹性选择器路径与主干线之间的相互干扰,我们实施一个控制的三阶段训练制度(详见第3.4节),逐步启动端对端耦合。 初始过渡点设定于第12个纪元之后,其中"弹性选手"开始训练,但尚未影响骨干. 在1阶段培训中对损失趋同模式的分析确定,第二阶段跨越3个时期,足以在启动联合优化之前稳定弹性选择器(第3阶段)。

blocks.en: As Phase 1 and 3 share the total epochs of 33, the key of optimizing 3-phase strategy is to balance them. Figure 3 demonstrates critical tradeoffs: the shorter Phase 1 cause the noise in early-training, the shorter Phase 3 hinder the joint optimization. They both decrease the final accuracy.
blocks.zh: 由于第一阶段和第三阶段分担33个时代的总任务,优化三阶段战略的关键是平衡它们。 图3显示了关键的权衡:第一阶段的较短造成早期训练中的噪音,第三阶段的较短妨碍联合优化。 两者都降低了最终准确度.

blocks.en: Discussion on lower selection rates of stage3. During the ablation experiments on training strategies, we observed a phenomenon in Table 2 : the sparsity rate at stage 3 is noticeably lower than that of other stages. Examining the model structure, we speculate that this may reflect an adaptation of Elastic Selection to network depth. As shown in Figure 2 , the number of Elastic Selection executions corresponds to the depth, and a lower sparsity rate at greater depth may imply selecting fewer but more critical windows each time, thereby achieving foreground coverage through multiple selections. As this is not a central focus of our work, only a tentative discussion is provided here.
blocks.zh: 关于降低第3阶段甄选率的讨论。 在关于培训战略的减速试验中,我们观察到表2中的一种现象:第三阶段的痉挛率明显低于其他阶段。 考察模型结构,我们推测这可能反映出"弹性选择"对网络深度的修改. 如图2所示, " 弹性选择 " 处决的数量与深度相对应,深度较低的 " 弹性选择 " 处决率可能意味着每次选择较少但更关键的窗口,从而通过多次选择实现前景覆盖。 由于这不是我们工作的中心重点,在此仅作初步讨论。

blocks.zh: 表3:不同配置和阶段的Windows选择率和AP 50. Pseudo-GT是指检测头的输出. 第三阶段的比率总是最低的。

blocks.en: 4.5 Backbone-agnostic Study
blocks.zh: 4.5 后骨不可知论 学习

blocks.en: We keenly observe that the proposed ElasticSelector is backbone‑agnostic and can be applied to both convolution‑based and Transformer‑based architectures. After implementing ElasticFormer on Transformer, we further obtained ElasticNet by replacing the self‑attention modules with convolutional layers. As shown in Table 1 , when combined with DINO and compared against ResNet‑50, this validation backbone achieves a 87% reduction in computation while delivering competitive detection quality. This provides strong evidence that ElasticSelector can be applied to various backbones, dynamically adjusting computation according to the foreground proportion.
blocks.zh: 我们强烈地看到,拟议的“弹性选择器”是骨干“不可知”的,可以适用于基于革命的建筑和基于变形器的建筑。 在“变形器”上执行“弹性前导”之后,我们通过用革命层取代自觉模块,进一步获得了“弹性网”。 如表1所示,如果与DINO合并,与ResNet-50相比,这一验证主干线在提供竞争性检测质量的同时,实现了87%的计算下降。 这提供了强有力的证据,证明弹性选择器可以应用于各种骨干,根据前景比例动态调整计算.

blocks.en: 4.6 WSOD Study
blocks.zh: 4.6 爆炸物处理 学习

blocks.en: Methodology. Since bounding box annotations are absent in Weakly Supervised Object Detection (WSOD), the loss in the DINO [ 40 ] detection head based on them must be replaced. Inspired by CDTR [ 8 ] and other Transformer-based approaches, we incorporate the Smooth L1 loss, training with numerous pseudo BBoxes generated by the model.
blocks.zh: 方法论. 由于弱监督物体探测(WSOD)中缺少边框说明,因此必须替换基于这些说明的DINO [40]探测头的损失. 在CDTR [8] 和其他基于变形器的方法的启发下,我们融入了平滑L1损失,用模型产生的众多伪BBox进行训练.

blocks.en: Datasets. We conduct weakly supervised experiments on the PASCAL VOC 2007 [ 1 ] dataset, which is split into training, validation, and test subsets. It comprises 9,963 annotated images containing 24,640 object instances spanning 20 distinct categories. The images have an overall resolution on the order of 10 5 10^{5} pixels, placing them in the non-HRW shots regime. This configuration provides a robust benchmark for evaluating ElasticFormer’s performance across diverse detection scenarios and target classes.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们在PASCAL VOC 2007 [1] 数据集上进行监督不力的实验,该数据集分为培训、验证和测试子集。 它包括9 963个附加说明的图像,包含24 640个对象实例,涉及20个不同的类别。 图像有10 5 10^{5}像素的总分辨率,将其置于非HRW射击制度. 这种配置为评价ElasticFormer在各种检测情景和目标类别中的表现提供了一个强有力的基准。

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. Moving to evaluation, we use mAP and CorLoc as the metrics and the computational costs are measured on 224×224 resolution inputs. To ensure fair comparison, all transformer-based and convolution-based detectors are evaluated after the same epochs of training separately. We estimate the computation on ElasticFormer by averaging measurements across the test set due to elastic computation.
blocks.zh: 评价尺度。 关于评价,我们用mAP和CorLoc作为衡量尺度,计算费用用224x224分辨率输入法计量。 为确保公平比较,所有基于变压器的和基于转录的探测器在同一个培训时代之后分别进行评估。 我们估计弹性前置器的计算方式是,由于弹性计算,整个测试组平均测量。

blocks.en: Data analysis. As evidenced by Table 3 , our sparsification approach reduces computational load by up to 70% on non-HRW shots, compared with Swin-T [ 28 ] . Further, ElasticFormer achieves gains in both mAP and CorLoc. It is noteworthy that in WSOD tasks, computation devoted to foreground regions increases markedly on non-HRW shots. This demonstrates that ElasticFormer can dynamically adjust its resource allocation to more effectively extract features in object-relevant areas.
blocks.zh: 数据分析。 如表3所示,与Swin-T [28] 相比,我国的抽筋方法将非HRW镜头的计算负荷减少了70%。 此外,ElasticFormer在mAP和CorLoc都取得了收益. 值得注意的是,在WSOD任务中,针对前景区域的计算在非HRW镜头上显著增加. 这表明ElasticFormer可以动态调整其资源分配,以更有效地提取与对象相关的领域的特征.

blocks.en: This significant efficiency gain persists even when target density falls below typical HRW thresholds, thereby demonstrating the generalizability beyond specialized high-resolution contexts, including WSOD tasks, of our method.
blocks.zh: 即使目标密度低于典型的人权观察阈值,这种显著的效率收益依然存在,从而表明我们的方法在专业的高分辨率背景下,包括WSOD任务之外,具有普遍适用性。

By using ElasticSelector’s score-driven sparse selection, we retain only ρ ^ ⋅ n \hat{\rho}\cdot n windows for detailed feature extraction. blocks.en: This efficiency gain arises from our target-coverage-ratio–based elastic computation modulation, which enables ElasticFormer to achieve high detection efficiency. Figure 4 also includes examples from both the PANDA [ 2 ] and PASCAL VOC 2007 [ 1 ] datasets, demonstrating the method’s effectiveness across different detection scenarios, tasks and object classes.

blocks.en: 4.8 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.8 读取研究

blocks.en: Ablation study on α \alpha and γ \gamma . We conduct a joint ablation study by selecting three values for each. Here we introduce a new metric, F-ratio, F-ratio = ( FLOPs-F / FLOPs-O ) × 100 % \text{F-ratio}=(\text{FLOPs-F}/\text{FLOPs-O})\times 100\% . This metric reflects the backbone’s attention to foreground regions. Increasing γ \gamma reduces computational cost at the expense of AP50, highlighting the trade-off between efficiency and accuracy. F-ratio shows no significant association with γ \gamma .
blocks.zh: α-α和γ-γ的校对研究. 我们通过选择每个值的三个值进行联合消化研究。 在此引入一个新的度量衡, F- ratio, F- ratio = (FLOPs- F / FLOPs- O )\ 100%\ text{ F- ratio} (\ text{ FLOPs- F}/\ text{ FLOPs- O})\ times 100\ 。 这一衡量标准反映了骨干对前景区域的关注。 增加 γ\gamma 降低计算成本,牺牲AP50,突出效率和准确性之间的权衡. F-ratio显示与γ\gamma没有重大关联.

blocks.en: In contrast, decreasing α \alpha proportionally reduces the supervised signal ρ \rho , which also lowers FLOPs-O. Interestingly, AP 50 does not follow the same trend; it reaches its peak when α = 0.8 \alpha=0.8 . By examining F-ratio, we observe that smaller α \alpha values correspond to higher F-ratios, indicating that the backbone focuses more on foreground regions. Therefore, tuning α \alpha enables a trade-off between computational cost and foreground attention, leading to optimal detection performance.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,下降的α-α比例减小了导电信号 ^\rho,这也降低了FLOPs-O. 有趣的是,AP50没有遵循同样的趋势;在α=0.8\α=0.8时达到峰值. 通过检查F-ratio,我们观察到较小的α-α值与较高的F-ratios相对应,表明骨干更注重前缘区域. 因此,对α-α的调试可以使计算成本与前置注意力相权衡,从而产生最佳的检测性能.

blocks.en: Table 4 : AP 50 and FLOPs across different α \alpha and γ \gamma . F-ratio is the proportion of foreground computation to the total, indicating a backbone’s attention to foreground regions.

blocks.en: Ablation study on scoring mechanism. We further conduct ablation experiments on different window scoring mechanisms, including small learned objectness and gradient density. The results show that small learned objectness can slightly improve foreground selection accuracy, but it requires an additional prediction head and thus introduces noticeable latency. Gradient density captures edge and texture information, which is sensitive to noise and incurs extra computational overhead. In contrast, our variance-based scoring mechanism is lightweight and does not rely on additional network components, leading to significantly lower latency while maintaining competitive detection accuracy. This demonstrates a superior balance between efficiency and accuracy.
blocks.zh: 关于评分机制的研究. 我们进一步对不同的窗口评分机制,包括小的学习对象和梯度密度进行减速实验. 结果显示,小的学习对象可以略微提高前景选择的精度,但需要增加一个预测头,从而引入明显的耐久性. 梯度密度捕捉边缘和纹理信息,这种信息对噪音很敏感,并会产生额外的计算间接费用. 相比之下,我们基于差异的评分机制是轻量级的,不依赖额外的网络组件,导致耐久性显著降低,同时保持竞争性检测精度. 这表明效率与准确性之间有较好的平衡。

blocks.en: Table 5 : AP 50 , FLOPs and latency across different scoring machanism. Latency is measured as the average over four stages, 100 forward passes of the backbone.
blocks.zh: 表5:AP 50,跨不同评分机制的FLOP和纬度. 延迟是按四个阶段平均100次骨干前传衡量的。

blocks.en: Ablation study on adaptive sparsity rates. SparseFormer [ 22 ] also adopts the concept of sparsity rate, but it uses a fixed parameter preset to 0.7. We choose this parameter from [ 0.1 , 0.3 , 0.5 , 0.7 , 1.0 ] [0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7,1.0] to study SparseFormer’s performance under different sparsity rates. The experiments are conducted with both DINO [ 40 ] and Dynamic-Head [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 关于适应性痉挛率的研究。 SparseFormer [22] 也采用了sparsity rate的概念,但它使用固定参数预设为0.7. 我们从[0.1、0.3、0.5、0.7、1.0][0.1、0.3、0.5、0.7、1.0]中选择这一参数,以研究SparseFormer在不同痉挛率下的性能。 实验用DINO[40]和Dynamic-head[10]进行。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : AP 50 vs. sparsity rate on SparseFormer and ElasticFormer. The annotated data in the figure is obtained through linear interpolation.
blocks.zh: 图5:SparseFormer和ElasticFormer上的AP 50对斯帕塞Forsity率. 图中的注解数据通过线性插值获取.

blocks.en: Regardless of the detection head, SparseFormer suffers a sharp drop in AP 50 when the sparsity rate is small. With the same sparsity rate as ElasticFormer, its AP 50 is consistently at least 15% lower. This highlights the importance of dynamic sparsity in addressing target number variations in HRW scenarios.
blocks.zh: 不论检测头部如何,SparseFormer在Sparseformer的Sparsity率很小时,AP 50会急剧下降. 其麻痹率与ElasticFormer相同,其AP50持续下降至少15%. 这突出表明了动态垃圾对解决人权观察方案目标数量变化的重要性。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We propose ElasticFormer, a Vision Transformer that dynamically allocates computation for HRW shot detection via its lightweight ElasticSelector module. By estimating target-coverage ratios ρ ^ \hat{\rho} and prioritizing high-variance regions, it reduces FLOPs by 90.2% versus Swin-T [ 28 ] and 82.7% versus SparseFormer [ 22 ] while achieving 80.6% AP50 on PANDA [ 2 ] . The framework’s backbone-agnostic design enables adaptive token utilization across stages, cutting background computation by 91.1%. This elastic paradigm establishes a new standard for efficient large-scale vision systems, particularly for real-time applications with constrained resources.
blocks.zh: 我们提议使用“ElasticFormer”这个视觉变形器, 通过估计目标覆盖率 ^ ^ ^ \ rho} 并优先确定高变异区域,FLOPs比Swin-T [28]减少90.2%,比SparseFormer [22]减少82.7%,同时在PANDA[2]上实现80.6%的AP50. 框架的骨干不可知设计可以使适应标志在各阶段得到利用,将背景计算削减91.1%。 这种弹性范式为高效的大视野系统,特别是资源有限的实时应用,确立了新的标准.
